title: Color Contrast Checker
seoTitle: Color Contrast Checker — WCAG AA and AAA
description: Check the WCAG contrast ratio of two hex colors. See AA and AAA pass or fail for normal text, large text and UI graphics. Runs locally.
intro: Enter a foreground and background hex color. The checker computes the WCAG relative-luminance ratio and marks AA and AAA thresholds.
blurb: Measure WCAG contrast between two hex colors for text and interface graphics.
howItWorks: Press Check contrast. Relative luminance follows the WCAG 2 formula.
Compare the ratio with 4.5:1 and 3:1 for AA, and 7:1 and 4.5:1 for AAA.
examples: #1A1A1A on #FFFFFF is a high-contrast pair that passes AAA for normal text.
#777777 on #FFFFFF is a common mid-gray that often fails AA for normal text.
Short #RGB values such as #FFF are expanded before the ratio is calculated.

faq.q: What ratio is required for WCAG AA?
faq.a: Normal text needs at least 4.5:1. Large text and non-text UI components need at least 3:1. AAA raises normal text to 7:1 and large text to 4.5:1.
No. Only opaque hex colors are compared. Flatten transparent colors onto the real background before checking.
It applies the published WCAG contrast formula for a quick check. It is not a substitute for a full accessibility review of a page.
